# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's specs call for slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and vertical slats may droop.
- Details: [RottenWiFi review](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)
- I don't have a direct store link for it, so search the name on Amazon or Belkin's site.

**Fastest charging: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99**
- It does Qi2 25W with active cooling, which helps on hot days with navigation running.
- Anker's A2933 is listed as incompatible with Tesla and Mercedes-Benz vehicles. Its vent clip fits blades from 10 to 24 mm.
- Sources disagree on the adapter: one says a 60W adapter is in the box, another says you need a 45W+ car adapter. Check the listing before buying.
- The Gadgeteer saw it discounted to $69.99.
- Details: [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) (their daily driver) and [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost, $39.99**
- Code **PARTNER18** takes it to about **$32.80**. Dealectric tested the code in ESR's cart on 2026-10-25, but the store's checkout has the final word.
- [Buy it here](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- The Gadgeteer notes the car adapter may not be included, which can add $10 to $15.
- Prices for ESR's mounts vary a lot between sources, so compare before ordering.

**Cheap 25W option: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, about $39.95**
- The Gadgeteer names it best overall. A 95W adapter is included.
- Running the fan matters: with it off, output is capped at 15W.
- Details: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**If you don't need charging: VICSEED Steel Core Vent Mount**
- It has a metal-core vent clip and a simpler build. Mount Guys picked it from research rather than hands-on testing.
- [Mount Guys guide](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)

## Quick tips
- Look for a **Qi2 or Qi2.2** badge. "MagSafe-compatible" without it may only charge at 7.5W.
- To reach 25W, you need your phone to support it (iPhone 16 and 17 series) and a strong enough USB-C car adapter.
- If your vents are flimsy, a dash or windshield suction mount is more stable.

If you tell me your phone and car (vent style, Tesla or not), I can narrow it to one pick.
